fallback: All methods use the original R4 decision below the common 4096-point optimization threshold. Above it, infeasible full-depth plans use R4. Technical/resource errors terminate the build; no algorithm substitution.
root_commit: only the actually selected root, then largest-node-first priority queue
depth_semantics: Original receding horizon: planning H is independent of remaining final depth; committed nodes obey depth<=8.
timing: R4 model load through layout and compact serialization; point/query input loading excluded. PostgreSQL COPY, CREATE INDEX and ANALYZE separate.
CPU_QMF: Original uniform_qmf CPU analytic sampler; full cost table and sorting included; no Qiskit or hardware quantum execution.
control_note: Cost-H1 changes the planning horizon to 1 and minimizes the identical two-term leaf cost; all other construction settings are shared.

sampling.method: NumPy PCG64 uniform without replacement from all source row ordinals; nested prefixes of random draw, sorted for streaming extraction

precision: Frozen full-data affine transform; points cast once to float32 and exactly promoted to float64 identically for both systems; query bounds remain float64, never rounded to float32 or adjusted after results.
construction_timing: R4 model load through layout and compact serialization; point/query input loading excluded. PostgreSQL COPY, CREATE INDEX and ANALYZE separate.

tuning.selection: Fixed hashed validation IDs, three rounds; select lowest aggregate mean completed client latency; all candidates reported; no formal query latency used.

client_timing: Monotonic steady_clock from bound formatting through PQexecPrepared response; scalar parsing/checking and logging excluded for both systems. One client, one query at a time.
